mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an improving labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates growing consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show positive growth, it indicates a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both increase > 1% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
